commentText: // Return no tax regions so receipt layout tests do not run tax discovery.
rationale: The test double controls a local test boundary. Naming it receiptLayoutExecutorWithoutTaxDiscovery expresses its purpose without a comment or an external design constraint.

commentText: // Keep incomplete addresses out of the carrier upload and send them for repair.
rationale: The selection and destinations are fully represented by the executable steps. Clearer collection names or a partition function can express the distinction without prose.

commentText:
// External auditors verify historical signatures against these exact bytes.
// Equivalent re-encoding breaks their evidence chain; retain the original payload.
rationale: Storing bytes shows the current representation but cannot establish the external audit obligation that forbids replacing it with an equivalent encoding. The constraint must remain available to future maintainers.

commentText:
// A clean sensor reading does not authorize release from quarantine.
// The operating license requires an independent inspector's clearance after any leak.
rationale: The condition expresses the release checks but not the licensing authority or the required independence of the inspector. Those external requirements explain why sensor recovery cannot replace clearance.
